SELECT pu.target_uid, pu.create_time, pu.update_time, pu.last_news, um.nickname as targetName, um.avatar as targetAvatar, um.occupation as targetOccupation FROM b_private_user AS pu LEFT JOIN b_user_main AS um ON pu.target_uid = um.uuid where pu.uid = #{bo.uid}
ORDER BY pu.update_time DESC, pu.create_time DESC
